title: Agent-native conversation authority, precise context and truthful native turn observation
user_story: A researcher asks natural questions while an agent chooses its strategy inside one evidence-based, permission-scoped research environment.

requirements.description: Ordinary conversation reaches the model intact; only explicit commands select a backend workflow.
Model-proposed actions retain schema, permission and approval enforcement.
Intermediate assistant messages cannot close native turns or hide later failures and actual usage.
Incremental CLI observations and errors reach the caller with owned cancellation and bounded cleanup.
Custom scientific purpose/system prompt survives durable save without silent fixed-length clipping.

nonfunctional: Preserve existing API/SSE contracts, raw scientific evidence, user data, worktrees and every skills/agent file.
No new Research Engine, autonomy-level workflow stack, paid API fallback or protection bypass.
Mandatory software regression100% executed/PASS; desired100%coverage informational.
Live subscription inference, software fixture execution and scientific qualification remain separate evidence modes.
inputs: Native CLI events and existing policy/context
outputs: Model-led conversation or intentional tool invocation
preconditions: Reviewed installed-before-plan skills and owner architecture definition
postconditions: No keyword-selected scientific strategy is silently executed
No partial message suppresses later result/failure/usage
No unsupported L3/L4 or full learning claim
dependencies: Authorized official native CLI and isolated runtime for actual provider checks
acceptance_criteria: Behavioral RED/GREEN tests pass without weakening authorization
Affected regression and full independent software gate required
Actual Codex subscription request/response recorded separately; no key forwarding
Research autonomy and learning remain unqualified until their frozen evaluation completes

scenarios.expected: No keyword-selected run, role or truncated proposal replaces a plain request.
Long current request and its final constraints remain intact.
Model proposal cannot execute a research action before approval.
Explicit slash command retains its direct execution contract.
Provider failure after partial assistant text is surfaced.
Later actual result and usage survive intermediate assistant messages.
First observation is delivered before controlled completion, within the frozen2second test bound.
Closing a reader cancels only its owned request and releases the producer.
Startup failure becomes a prompt provider error rather than an indefinite wait.
Complete scientific purpose and system prompt survive disk reload.

recovery: Preserve original failures and all attempts. Bounded development repair, exact request cancellation, no retries that hide failures. Missing live/research/UAT remains BLOCKED.
test_environment: MOCKED model/transport with real disposable backend state, actual controlled Python protocol processes and async boundaries; not scientific or remote CI proof.

review.method: Same-agent source and adversarial behavior review; independent acceptance/scientific review remains pending.

limitations: Formal machine traceability consolidates the prior owner directive, source audit and actual RED/GREEN; it is not independent review.
Required new exploratory journey adapters remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED; the old one-use settings UAT cannot qualify all these journeys.
Actual provider receipts are synthetic connection checks, not full source release qualification or research validity.
